instruction: Create a shell script file named 'run.sh' in /home/user and make it executable.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a script file and making it executable. Evaluator checks the file permissions to verify the executable bit is set for the user.

File existence is implicitly verified (getter returns None if file doesn't exist, metric returns 0.0)
Logic flow is sound and will work correctly at runtime
